prompt: Write a product review for a fictional coffee maker called the BrewMaster 3000. The review should be 100–150 words, written in first person, and mention at least one specific feature and one drawback.
Write a haiku about artificial intelligence. A haiku has three lines: 5 syllables, 7 syllables, 5 syllables. Output only the haiku — no title, no explanation.
Write a 3-paragraph short story about a robot chef who discovers that food tastes different depending on who you cook it for. Each paragraph should be 3–5 sentences. Do not include a title.

Write a professional email politely declining a meeting request due to a scheduling conflict. The email should have a subject line, greeting, body (2–3 sentences), and a closing. Keep it under 80 words total.
Write a limerick about debugging code. A limerick has 5 lines with the rhyme scheme AABBA. Output only the limerick.
